# Oryon AI Search Readiness Score

> Free, open-source scorer for AI-search readiness. Give it any public URL and it
> returns a 0-100 score across 27 deterministic signals in 5 buckets (schema &
> structure, content format, authority, crawlability, freshness), plus concrete
> fixes. No signup, no LLM calls, no API keys. Built by SEOryon, MIT licensed.

The scorer runs entirely from raw HTML — the same thing AI crawlers receive.
Scoring is deterministic: same page, same score. The hosted API is
`GET /api/score?url=<url>` and returns JSON.

## Docs

- [How it works](https://score.seoryon.com/): the scoring page, with every signal and weight explained
- [Source code](https://github.com/SEOryon/oryon-score): the full engine, MIT — the hosted tool runs this exact code
- [Python package](https://pypi.org/project/oryon-score/): `pip install oryon-score` for CLI or library use

## Related tools

- [AI Citability Grader](https://cite.seoryon.com): paste text, get a 7-factor citability score
- [SEO ROI calculator](https://roi.seoryon.com): what organic traffic is worth, in your numbers
- [SEOryon](https://seoryon.com): the company behind these tools
